summary: Fitness Champs Holdings filed a 6-K announcing an EGM on June 29, 2026, to vote on increasing authorized share capital from US$500,000 to US$23,000,000 via a massive increase in Class A shares (from 177.8M to 10.2B) while keeping Class B and preferred shares unchanged. This is a structural capital change, likely to facilitate future capital returns or acquisitions. No price, premium, or advisor details; the board recommends approval. The mechanics involve amending the memorandum and articles. Watch for shareholder approval and subsequent use of the authorized shares—potential dilution or capital return event.
